note: Exact-match allowlist for tools/secret-scan.mjs (BUILD-CONTRACT 4.14). It holds sha256 hashes, never the key strings. A hit is allowed only when ALL hold: the pattern name matches; the sha256 of the matched string is listed; the file path (relative to the scan root, forward slashes) matches pathRe; and the match lies inside the <script> element whose id is insideScriptId (plain HTML or JSON-escaped markup). Any other occurrence, even the same key, stays a hit.

entries.why: Jane (iheartjane) Boost public client keys. They are published in the live San Pedro shop page HTML and are required by the Jane embed, which is kept byte-identical (BUILD-CONTRACT 4.6, OPEN-DECISIONS A13). They are not our credentials.
entries.evidence: audit/raw/location-san-pedro-shop.html, the <script id="jane-app-secrets"> element: 2 distinct keys, 0 occurrences outside it (measured 2026-10-13).
